name: Hinata
source:
An alcohol-loving "cat" that lives in the mansion Saki and Makoto wanders into, Hinata is capable of switching between his feline and human form at his whim. In spite of his laziness, he hates being bored and constantly seeks amusement.

Foul-mouthed and not above thievery, Hinata doesn't have a very good personality. He prizes his hair (or fur?), and is somewhat of a narcissist. He sees Saki more like a toy, and never passes up the chance to give her a hard time.

[Translation of the [URL=http://www.mead-soft.net/sakuragatari/character.php]official website's[/URL] character profile.]
